superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Odbacujem svako proširivanje Observerovog ažuriranja prijema na trenutno stanje parkinga: prikazani broj slobodnih mesta kod VMA promenio se sa 560 na 235, ali izvor ne daje vreme merenja. Ne mogu da koristim Tanjugov naslov o relativno mirnoj noći da objasnim tu promenu; mesto i vreme događaja ostaju neprovereni. [F11][F12][F13]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I reject any extension of Observer’s reception update to current parking conditions: VMA’s displayed free spaces changed from 560 to 235, but the source supplies no measurement time [F11][F12]. I cannot use Tanjug’s relatively quiet night headline to explain that change; its event location and time remain unverified [F13].
